Olivia Richman is a seasoned esports journalist who has worked with Inven Global, Esports Illustrated, Esports.gg, and more. When not working and gaming, Olivia loves collecting Kirby plush, eating sushi, and driving her cars at the track.

“We are not taking an esports product and placing it in a casino lobby,” Market Suchar, the co-founder and managing director at Oddin.gg says.

Suchar’s comments came asOddin announced the launch of its new venture, Oddin Casino, which will see the esports specialist branching out into casino gaming.

“Casino has its own rules, audiences, and creative language,” Suchar added. “We are building for those realities from the ground up — but with the same conviction that technology should give our partners a genuine competitive advantage.”

Oddin’s homepage, which for now focuses on its esports products, declares: “The more time lines are open, the more time bettors can bet, and the more money you can make.”
